newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian state note issue raises 1.017 bln bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian state note issue raises 1.017 bln bfr.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury said on Tuesday its issue of two state notes, targeted at retail investors, raised 1.017 billion Belgian francs on Monday, the first day of subscriptions.
The subscription period runs to June 3.
A five-year par-priced note, extendable to seven years, with a fixed 4.70 percent coupon raised 821.7 million francs.

A par-priced note, with put options at three, five and seven years, with a guaranteed minimum 3.85 percent coupon raised 196.1 million francs. The guaranteed minimum coupons at five and seven years would rise to 4.70 and 5.35 percent.
